title: F1Jobs.io
synopsis: Bhavini runs sales and operations at F1Jobs.io, from the first lead to the closed deal. Seven sales in, she has brought in $100K+ in revenue, become the face of the brand online, and improved workflow efficiency by 65%.

episodes.title: The Pipeline
episodes.synopsis: She owns the B2B/D2C lead-generation pipeline: lead hunting, prospect identification, outreach, qualification and follow-up that turn into new business.

episodes.title: Seven Sales
episodes.synopsis: Generated $100,000+ in revenue through 7+ successful D2C sales by engaging prospects and supporting the company's core business model.

episodes.title: Face of the Brand
episodes.synopsis: Leads social media marketing and appears as the face of F1Jobs.io on the company's website, strengthening brand presence and audience engagement.

episodes.title: Ticket Zero
episodes.synopsis: Manages customer-facing operations and resolved 20+ customer tickets, improving workflow efficiency by 65% through structured issue resolution and process coordination.
